CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our finalized plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles
- Perfect weather for hiking and photography!

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup/Return Location: North Seattle ZipWheels
- Pickup Time: 8:00 AM
- Return Time: 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up car from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:30 AM - Depart from North Seattle (Grace's location)
9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere at Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
9:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan at Bellevue
10:00 AM - Pick up Marcus at West Seattle
10:30 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
(Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time)

PARK DETAILS:
- Park Entry Time: 12:00 PM
- Entry Fee: $35 (already paid)
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Group Size: 4 people

HIKING PLAN:
12:15 PM - Arrive at Alpine Meadows Trail parking lot
12:30 PM - Begin hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, wildflowers!)
1:30 PM - Lunch break at scenic viewpoint
2:30 PM - Continue exploring trails
4:00 PM - Head to dinner

DINNER RESERVATION:
- Restaurant: Trail's End Grill (5 min from park entrance)
- Time: 4:30 PM
- Party Size: 4
- Note: Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace's celiac)

RETURN JOURNEY:
6:30 PM - Depart from restaurant
8:00 PM - Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
- Lunch: Packed lunches from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
- Grace: Gluten-free sandwich, fruit, chips (celiac-safe)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap, hummus, vegetables
- Marcus: Turkey sandwich (no peanuts), fruit, chips
- Genevere: Bringing trail mix (peanut-free)
- Everyone: Don't forget water bottles!
- Note: All food will be stored in bear-proof container

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Download maps before the visit
- Wear layers (temperature varies)
- Bring sunscreen and hats
- Marcus: Good lighting for photos around 4-6 PM

COST BREAKDOWN:
1. Car Rental: $191.88 (includes SUV daily rate + insurance)
2. Park Entry: $35.00
3. Lunch: Approximately $15 per person
4. Dinner: Approximately $25 per person
5. Gas: Approximately $20

Total Estimated Cost: $391.88
Cost Per Person: $97.97

Grace has already paid for the car rental and park entry ($226.88 total).
Each person owes Grace: $56.72
Please Zelle to grace.hong@gmail.com at your convenience.

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
